description: RDA-064 semantic gold benchmark. Each case supplies a claim and evidence text (both textually grounded in the source) plus the expected semantic validation status a correct validator should assign. Tests whether the LLM semantic validator distinguishes supported from paraphrased, causal, generalized, antonym, scope, temporal, conditional, contradictory and partially-supported claims.
